_meta.note: TDS version numbers, SQL Server compatibility, and feature support matrix

version_numbers.description: TDS version numbers exchanged in PRELOGIN and LOGIN7. Client sends version to server; server sends its version back.
version_numbers.note: DoneRowCount in DONE token: TDS 7.0/7.1 = always LONG (4 bytes); TDS 7.2+ = LONG or ULONGLONG (8 bytes) depending on server. Use VERSION from Pre-Login response to determine.

notes: fByteOrder=1 supported only by this version
userType in COLMETADATA becomes ULONG (4 bytes)
TDS 0x03000A73 does NOT support NBCROW and fSparseColumnSet
datetime2, datetimeoffset, date, time types added

versions.client_to_server: N/A (TLS at TCP level; PRELOGIN uses TLS-encrypted channel)
notes: TLS established BEFORE PRELOGIN (not inside TDS packets)
ENCRYPT_CLIENT_CERT (0x80 bit: 0x80/0x81/0x83) in PRELOGIN for certificate auth
TDS 8.0 is only available with SQL Server 2022+ on Linux and in TDS 7.x flow for SS2022/SS2025

done_rowcount_rules.description: DONE token DoneRowCount field width depends on TDS version
done_rowcount_rules.tds_72_plus: LONG or ULONGLONG (8 bytes) — server determines based on negotiated TDS version
done_rowcount_rules.detection: Use VERSION field in Pre-Login Response: if VERSION indicates SQL Server 7.0 or SQL Server 2000, DoneRowCount is LONG; otherwise ULONGLONG
done_rowcount_rules.implementation_note: If client cannot determine server TDS version before login, DoneRowCount is ambiguous. SQL Server Native Client (SNAC) uses VERSION option in Pre-Login response.

collation_version_field.description: Version field in COLLATION structure (5 bytes) indicates collation generation

feature_support_matrix.description: Which FeatureExt features are supported by each SQL Server version
feature_support_matrix.note: AZURESQLSUPPORT and FEDAUTH are supported by Azure SQL Database, not by on-premises SQL Server

features.supported_from: Not supported by SQL Server (Azure SQL Database only per §6 notes)
features.notes: Used for session state recovery on reconnect. StateIds 0x01-0x09.

features.sql_server_support: NOT supported by SQL Server (note <4> and <16> and <23>)

features.notes: Always Available Encryption; enclave computations require SS2019+ and .NET 4.7.2+

features.supported_from: NOT supported by SQL Server (Azure SQL Database only)
features.notes: FeatureData value is always 0 from SQL Server
JSON native type support. Requires PLP encoding for data.
VECTOR type support. Wire format: ActualLen(2B) + float32 elements.
Added in v20260223 (most recent change to spec)

prelogin_encryption_values.0x00: ENCRYPT_OFF — TLS not required (legacy; deprecated in TDS 8.0)
prelogin_encryption_values.0x01: ENCRYPT_ON — TLS required for login and data

altmetadata_support.note: ALTMETADATA and ALTROW tokens deprecated in TDS 7.4 (SQL Server 2012+)

altrow_support.note: ALTROW supported only in SQL Server 7.0, 2000, and 2005

nbcrow_sparse_support.note: SQL Server 2008 TDS 0x03000A73 does NOT support NBCROW and fSparseColumnSet. NBCROW/sparse supported from TDS 7.3.B (SQL Server 2008 R2) onwards.
